verdict.rationale: Beamer documents first-party engagement analytics: views, unique users and clicks for product updates, a Dashboard giving a bird's-eye view of customer communication, and user-activity features aimed at engagement and adoption. The evidence covers engagement with announcements, not broader product adoption across a workspace, and shows no programmatic way to retrieve the analytics. Missing for 10: workspace-wide product usage and adoption metrics, documented analytics retrieval or export via API, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can retrieve usage analytics to understand how the product is adopted across my workspace

citations.quote: Check views, unique users, clicks and more for all your product updates to track user engagement.
Get a bird's eye view of all your customer communication with Beamer's new Dashboard.
Layer in advanced features like segmentation and user activities to optimize for engagement and adoption.
